To appear for the end-term examination, the minimum attendance requirement is seventy-five percent (75%) of the classes actually conducted in every registered course [E4]. 

An additional relaxation may be granted down to a relaxed floor of sixty-five percent (65%) on specific grounds such as serious medical exigencies (hospitalization, trauma, or contagious disease) of the student or family members, or representing the State/India in events, subject to proper documentation and approval by the Vice-Chancellor [E1, E5]. Without meeting these requirements, students are not allowed to sit for the End Term Exam and receive an 'FA' grade in that course [E1, E3].

Next steps:
- Check your daily course-wise attendance on the Digii Portal [E4].
- Contact your respective faculty members for any concerns regarding your attendance [E4].
